title: TypeScript
public_summary: TypeScript API reference, generated pages, examples, demos, install flow, and package release material remain owned by graphrefly-ts.

public_sections.heading: Delegation Boundary
body: The shared site points to the TypeScript package docs and keeps cross-language concepts here. It does not copy generated TypeScript API pages or runnable example bodies into this repo.
bullets: Use graphrefly-ts for generated API pages and examples.
Use the shared site for concepts, guarantees, and cross-language guide records.
Treat hand-maintained TypeScript API mirrors in graphrefly as drift.
